_description: Hand-maintained sidecar metadata for @roboborealis/components components. Merged into src/agent/manifest.json by generate-manifest.ts. Add entries as needed — components without entries still appear in the manifest with null for these fields.

RoboButton.whenToUse: Primary user actions, form submissions, destructive confirmations
RoboButton.accessibilityNote: Uses native <button> element. Provide aria-label when children is an icon only

RoboIconButton.whenToUse: Toolbar actions, compact UI where space is limited
RoboIconButton.neverUse: Primary CTAs — use RoboButton with text instead
RoboIconButton.accessibilityNote: Always provide aria-label since there is no visible text

RoboCard.whenToUse: Content containers, dashboard widgets, list items with rich content
RoboCard.neverUse: Simple text blocks — use a plain div with spacing tokens
RoboCard.accessibilityNote: Use semantic heading levels inside card headers

RoboBadge.whenToUse: Status indicators, counts, labels next to text or icons
RoboBadge.neverUse: Long text content — use RoboChip for interactive labels
RoboBadge.accessibilityNote: Include aria-label when badge conveys meaning beyond decoration

RoboChip.whenToUse: Dismissible tags, filter chips, multi-select display values
RoboChip.neverUse: Static status indicators — use RoboBadge instead
RoboChip.accessibilityNote: Dismissible chips need aria-label describing what will be removed

RoboInput.whenToUse: Single-line text input, search fields, short form values
RoboInput.neverUse: Multi-line text — use RoboTextarea. Rich text — use RoboRichTextEditor
RoboInput.accessibilityNote: Always pair with a visible label or aria-label

RoboAccordion.whenToUse: Collapsible secondary information, FAQ sections, settings groups
RoboAccordion.neverUse: Primary content that should always be visible
RoboAccordion.accessibilityNote: Uses Radix accordion with proper aria-expanded and keyboard navigation

RoboDataTable.whenToUse: Any list of >5 rows needing sort, filter, pagination, or row selection
RoboDataTable.neverUse: Simple 2-3 column static lists — use Card + Stack instead
RoboDataTable.accessibilityNote: Provide aria-label on the table element. Row selection needs aria-selected

RoboAlert.whenToUse: Inline status messages that persist (errors, warnings, success confirmations)
RoboAlert.accessibilityNote: Uses role=alert for error/warning (assertive) or role=status for info/success (polite)

RoboDialog.whenToUse: Confirmations, destructive action prompts, modal forms
RoboDialog.neverUse: Browser confirm() or alert(). Non-blocking info — use RoboToast
RoboDialog.accessibilityNote: Traps focus, ESC to close, returns focus on dismiss. Uses Radix Dialog

RoboToast.neverUse: Persistent messages — use RoboAlert inline instead
RoboToast.accessibilityNote: Uses role=status with aria-live=polite. Auto-dismiss with configurable duration

RoboSkeleton.whenToUse: Loading states for content areas, cards, tables, text blocks
RoboSkeleton.neverUse: Button loading states — use RoboSpinner or button disabled state
RoboSkeleton.accessibilityNote: Add aria-busy=true on the container while loading

RoboSpinner.whenToUse: Inline loading indicators, button loading states, small areas
RoboSpinner.neverUse: Full-page or content-area loading — use RoboSkeleton

RoboPageShell.whenToUse: Root layout wrapper for every page — provides sidebar, topbar, and content area
RoboPageShell.neverUse: Nested inside other layout components — only one per page
RoboPageShell.accessibilityNote: Landmark regions (nav, main, aside) are built in

RoboGrid.whenToUse: 2+ column layouts, dashboard grids, card galleries
RoboGrid.accessibilityNote: Uses CSS Grid — no accessibility concerns beyond content order

RoboStack.whenToUse: Vertical sequences of elements with consistent spacing
RoboStack.accessibilityNote: Uses CSS Flexbox — no accessibility concerns beyond content order

RoboSidebar.whenToUse: App-level navigation, always visible on desktop, collapsible on mobile
RoboSidebar.neverUse: Content sidebars or secondary panels — use RoboFloatingPanel for map contexts
RoboSidebar.accessibilityNote: Uses <nav> landmark. Keyboard navigable with arrow keys

RoboTopbar.whenToUse: App header with branding, user menu, breadcrumbs
RoboTopbar.neverUse: Page-level headers — use standard heading elements

RoboTabs.whenToUse: Switching between related views without navigation
RoboTabs.neverUse: Multi-step wizards — use a stepper pattern. Navigation — use RoboSidebar
RoboTabs.accessibilityNote: Uses Radix Tabs with role=tablist, arrow key navigation

RoboMapbox.whenToUse: Any map view — provides theme-aware tile switching and consistent controls
RoboMapbox.neverUse: Raw mapbox-gl directly — always wrap in RoboMapbox
RoboMapbox.accessibilityNote: Map is role=application. Provide skip-to-content link before the map

RoboFloatingPanel.whenToUse: Detail panels, asset info, lists overlaid on the map
RoboFloatingPanel.neverUse: Outside map context — use RoboCard or RoboDialog for non-map views
RoboFloatingPanel.accessibilityNote: Draggable panels need keyboard alternative for repositioning

RoboEntityInspectorPanel.whenToUse: Any map click-to-inspect flow for a single feature (port, vessel, region, cable, train, traffic incident, etc.) — a compact teaser by default that expands into the full RoboEntityDossier on demand
RoboEntityInspectorPanel.neverUse: A view that should always show full detail with no compact state — use RoboEntityDossier directly inside your own RoboFloatingPanel instead
RoboEntityInspectorPanel.accessibilityNote: The expand/collapse icon toggle has an accessible label that flips between 'Show more' and 'Show less'; content transitions respect prefers-reduced-motion via useReducedMotion()

RoboMapOverlay.whenToUse: Container for multiple RoboFloatingPanel instances over the map. RoboMapbox wraps children in this automatically
RoboMapOverlay.neverUse: Directly inside RoboMapbox children — it is already provided. Adding another breaks magnetic snap
RoboMapOverlay.accessibilityNote: Manages z-index stacking of floating panels

RoboAssetLayer.whenToUse: Rendering vessel/asset markers on the map with icon sets
RoboAssetLayer.neverUse: Static markers — use mapbox-gl markers directly for non-asset points
RoboAssetLayer.accessibilityNote: Asset markers should have aria-label with vessel/asset name for screen readers

RoboRichTextEditor.whenToUse: Multi-line rich text input with formatting (bold, italic, lists, links)
RoboRichTextEditor.neverUse: Simple text — use RoboTextarea. Code input — use a code editor component
RoboRichTextEditor.accessibilityNote: Uses Slate.js with ARIA toolbar. Tab moves focus out of editor, Shift+Tab moves back in

RoboSelect.whenToUse: Dropdown selection from a predefined list of options
RoboSelect.neverUse: Free-text input — use RoboInput. Multi-select — use RoboCheckboxGroup or RoboChip with popover
RoboSelect.accessibilityNote: Uses Radix Select with keyboard navigation and proper listbox role

RoboFormField.whenToUse: Wrapping any form input to provide label, description, and error message
RoboFormField.neverUse: Outside of react-hook-form context — the field binds to form state
RoboFormField.accessibilityNote: Connects label to input via htmlFor. Error uses role=alert

RoboFlag.neverUse: As a button — wrap in RoboIconButton if clickable

RoboFlagSelect.whenToUse: Country/region selection dropdown with flag icons
RoboFlagSelect.accessibilityNote: Flag images have alt text with country names

RoboStatCard.whenToUse: Dashboard KPIs, summary metrics, at-a-glance numbers
RoboStatCard.accessibilityNote: Use aria-label to describe what the statistic represents

RoboLineChart.whenToUse: Time-series data, trends, continuous data visualization
RoboLineChart.accessibilityNote: Provide a data table alternative for screen readers

RoboBarChart.whenToUse: Categorical comparisons, discrete data points, rankings
RoboBarChart.accessibilityNote: Provide a data table alternative for screen readers

RoboProgress.whenToUse: Determinate progress indicators (file upload, multi-step completion)
RoboProgress.accessibilityNote: Uses role=progressbar with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax

RoboTooltip.whenToUse: Supplementary info on hover/focus for icons, truncated text, or controls
RoboTooltip.neverUse: Essential information — use visible text or RoboPopover for interactive content
RoboTooltip.accessibilityNote: Uses Radix Tooltip with proper aria-describedby linking

RoboPopover.whenToUse: Interactive content triggered by a button (filters, settings, mini-forms)
RoboPopover.neverUse: Static hover info — use RoboTooltip. Large forms — use RoboDialog
RoboPopover.accessibilityNote: Focus trapped inside popover. ESC to close

RoboActionButton.whenToUse: Contextual actions in toolbars, table rows, or card headers (edit, delete, share)
RoboActionButton.neverUse: Primary page actions — use RoboButton. Navigation — use next/link
RoboActionButton.accessibilityNote: Always provide aria-label describing the action

RoboAlertProvider.whenToUse: Wrap app root to enable useAlert() hook for programmatic inline alerts
RoboAlertProvider.neverUse: Directly — consumers use RoboAlert component or useAlert() hook
RoboAlertProvider.accessibilityNote: Manages ARIA live region announcements automatically

RoboAreaChart.whenToUse: Volume/quantity over time, stacked compositions, cumulative trends
RoboAreaChart.neverUse: Discrete comparisons — use RoboBarChart. Simple trends — use RoboLineChart
RoboAreaChart.accessibilityNote: Provide a data table alternative for screen readers

RoboAssetTooltip.whenToUse: Hover info on map asset markers showing vessel/asset quick details
RoboAssetTooltip.neverUse: Outside map context — use RoboTooltip for general UI tooltips
RoboAssetTooltip.accessibilityNote: Visible on focus as well as hover for keyboard users

RoboAvatar.whenToUse: User profile images, initials, or placeholder icons in headers, comments, lists
RoboAvatar.neverUse: Decorative images — use an img tag. Logo display — use brand assets
RoboAvatar.accessibilityNote: Include alt text for images or aria-label for initials

RoboBottomNav.whenToUse: Mobile navigation bar fixed to the bottom of the viewport
RoboBottomNav.neverUse: Desktop apps — use RoboSidebar. More than 5 items — use a hamburger menu

RoboBreadcrumbs.whenToUse: Hierarchical page navigation showing the user's location in the app
RoboBreadcrumbs.neverUse: Flat navigation — use RoboTabs. Deep hierarchies (>4 levels) — truncate middle items
RoboBreadcrumbs.accessibilityNote: Uses <nav aria-label='Breadcrumb'> with aria-current on last item

RoboBubbleChart.whenToUse: Three-dimensional data comparisons (x, y, and size) in scatter-like plots
RoboBubbleChart.neverUse: Simple two-variable correlation — use RoboLineChart scatter mode
RoboBubbleChart.accessibilityNote: Provide a data table alternative for screen readers

RoboCheckbox.whenToUse: Boolean toggles, multi-select in forms, terms acceptance
RoboCheckbox.neverUse: Mutually exclusive options — use RoboRadioGroup. Feature toggles — use RoboSwitch
RoboCheckbox.accessibilityNote: Always pair with a visible label. Indeterminate state needs aria-checked='mixed'

RoboCommandPalette.whenToUse: Global keyboard shortcut (Cmd+K) for quick navigation and actions
RoboCommandPalette.neverUse: Primary navigation — use RoboSidebar. Search — use RoboInput with search results
RoboCommandPalette.accessibilityNote: Uses combobox pattern with aria-activedescendant for list selection

RoboCompassControl.whenToUse: Map compass showing current bearing, click to reset north
RoboCompassControl.accessibilityNote: Provide aria-label='Reset map bearing to north'

RoboCoordinateDisplay.whenToUse: Showing cursor or point coordinates on the map (lat/lon)
RoboCoordinateDisplay.neverUse: Outside map context — use plain text for static coordinates
RoboCoordinateDisplay.accessibilityNote: Uses aria-live='polite' for real-time coordinate updates

RoboCopyButton.whenToUse: Copying text to clipboard (IDs, codes, URLs, coordinates)
RoboCopyButton.neverUse: Large content blocks — provide a download/export option instead
RoboCopyButton.accessibilityNote: Announces 'Copied' to screen readers via aria-live

RoboCourseIndicator.whenToUse: Displaying vessel heading/course as a compass direction indicator
RoboCourseIndicator.neverUse: General rotation/angle display — use plain text
RoboCourseIndicator.accessibilityNote: Include aria-label with numeric degrees and cardinal direction

RoboDatePicker.whenToUse: Date or date-range selection in forms (departures, deadlines, filters)
RoboDatePicker.neverUse: Time-only input — use a time input. Relative dates — use a select dropdown
RoboDatePicker.accessibilityNote: Calendar grid uses arrow keys for navigation. Pair with visible label

RoboDensityProvider.whenToUse: Wrap app root to enable density switching (comfortable/compact/spacious)
RoboDensityProvider.neverUse: Per-component density — apply data-density attribute directly
RoboDensityProvider.accessibilityNote: Compact density must still meet 44px minimum touch targets

RoboDivider.whenToUse: Visual separation between content sections or list groups
RoboDivider.neverUse: Spacing only — use margin/padding. Semantic sections — use heading hierarchy

RoboDrawControl.whenToUse: Drawing polygons, lines, or points on the map (geofencing, route planning)
RoboDrawControl.accessibilityNote: Provide keyboard alternative for drawing operations

RoboEmergencyPulseLayer.whenToUse: Highlighting emergency/distress signals on the map with animated pulse
RoboEmergencyPulseLayer.neverUse: Non-emergency alerts — use RoboZoneAlertLayer for zone-based warnings

RoboExportButton.whenToUse: Exporting table or list data to CSV/Excel

RoboFavoritesPanel.whenToUse: Quick-access panel for user-bookmarked items (vessels, reports, routes)
RoboFavoritesPanel.accessibilityNote: List items need descriptive aria-labels for remove/reorder actions

RoboForceGraph.neverUse: Hierarchical data — use a tree component. Simple lists — use RoboDataTable
RoboForceGraph.accessibilityNote: Provide a data table alternative. Interactive nodes need keyboard focus

RoboKrakenLoader.whenToUse: Full-page or large-area branded loading state with kraken animation
RoboKrakenLoader.neverUse: Small inline loading — use RoboSpinner. Content-area — use RoboSkeleton

RoboLayerSwitcher.whenToUse: Toggling map layer visibility (satellite, terrain, traffic, custom overlays)

RoboLiveTrackingToggle.whenToUse: Enabling/disabling real-time position updates on the map
RoboLiveTrackingToggle.accessibilityNote: Use aria-pressed to indicate toggle state

RoboMapControls.whenToUse: Container for grouping map control buttons (zoom, compass, layers)
RoboMapControls.neverUse: Non-map UI — use RoboStack or a toolbar pattern

RoboMapLegend.whenToUse: Explaining map symbology (colors, icons, zone types) to users
RoboMapLegend.neverUse: Outside map context — use a regular list or key
RoboMapLegend.accessibilityNote: All color meanings must also be conveyed via text/shape

RoboPieChart.whenToUse: Part-to-whole composition for 2-6 categories (status breakdowns, allocations)
RoboPieChart.neverUse: >6 categories — use RoboBarChart. Exact comparisons — use RoboBarChart
RoboPieChart.accessibilityNote: Provide a data table alternative for screen readers

RoboPrintButton.whenToUse: Triggering browser print dialog for reports or document views

RoboRadarChart.whenToUse: Multi-axis comparison of a single entity across dimensions (risk scoring, capabilities)
RoboRadarChart.neverUse: Temporal data — use RoboLineChart. Simple rankings — use RoboBarChart
RoboRadarChart.accessibilityNote: Provide a data table alternative for screen readers

RoboRadioGroup.whenToUse: Mutually exclusive selection from 2-5 visible options
RoboRadioGroup.neverUse: Many options — use RoboSelect. Boolean — use RoboCheckbox or RoboSwitch
RoboRadioGroup.accessibilityNote: Uses role=radiogroup with arrow key navigation between options

RoboScaleBar.whenToUse: Showing map distance scale (km/mi) for spatial reference
RoboScaleBar.accessibilityNote: Include aria-label with current scale value

RoboSeparator.whenToUse: Thin horizontal or vertical line between content sections

RoboShipWavesLoader.whenToUse: Default branded loading animation for maritime-themed applications
RoboShipWavesLoader.neverUse: Non-maritime apps — use RoboKrakenLoader or RoboSpinner

RoboSlider.whenToUse: Numeric range selection (time ranges, zoom levels, volume, filter thresholds)
RoboSlider.neverUse: Precise numeric input — use RoboInput type=number. Binary choices — use RoboSwitch
RoboSlider.accessibilityNote: Uses role=slider with aria-valuemin/max/now and keyboard arrows

RoboSosStrobe.whenToUse: Visual distress signal indicator on the map (MAYDAY/SOS events)
RoboSosStrobe.neverUse: Non-emergency status — use RoboBadge or RoboEmergencyPulseLayer

RoboSwitch.whenToUse: On/off toggles for settings, feature flags, real-time mode switches
RoboSwitch.neverUse: Multi-option selection — use RoboRadioGroup. Form boolean — use RoboCheckbox
RoboSwitch.accessibilityNote: Uses role=switch with aria-checked. Provide visible label

RoboTextarea.whenToUse: Multi-line plain text input (descriptions, notes, comments)
RoboTextarea.neverUse: Single-line values — use RoboInput. Rich text — use RoboRichTextEditor
RoboTextarea.accessibilityNote: Always pair with a visible label or aria-label

RoboThemeProvider.whenToUse: Wrap app root to enable theme switching (midnight/aurora) and mode (dark/light)
RoboThemeProvider.neverUse: Per-component theming — set data-theme attribute directly
RoboThemeProvider.accessibilityNote: Ensures color contrast meets WCAG AA in all theme/mode combinations

RoboTimeline.whenToUse: Chronological event sequences (audit logs, voyage history, activity feeds)
RoboTimeline.neverUse: Static lists — use RoboStack. Interactive timelines — consider RoboTimelineControl
RoboTimeline.accessibilityNote: Use ordered list semantics. Each event needs a timestamp announced

RoboTimelineControl.whenToUse: Playback scrubber for historical position replay on the map
RoboTimelineControl.neverUse: Outside map context — use RoboSlider for generic time ranges
RoboTimelineControl.accessibilityNote: Uses role=slider with time-based labels for aria-valuenow

RoboTreasureMap.whenToUse: Branded empty state illustration when no data matches filters or first-use
RoboTreasureMap.neverUse: Error states — use RoboAlert. Loading — use RoboSkeleton
RoboTreasureMap.accessibilityNote: Decorative — mark with aria-hidden='true'. Convey empty state via visible text

RoboZoneAlertLayer.whenToUse: Highlighting geographic zones with alert states (restricted areas, risk zones)
RoboZoneAlertLayer.neverUse: Static zone display — use standard GeoJSON polygons
RoboZoneAlertLayer.accessibilityNote: Zone alerts should be announced via aria-live for screen reader users

RoboZoomControl.whenToUse: Zoom in/out buttons on the map
RoboZoomControl.accessibilityNote: Buttons need aria-label='Zoom in' and 'Zoom out'

RoboInView.description: Viewport-triggered entrance animation wrapper using IntersectionObserver
RoboInView.whenToUse: Animating content in as the user scrolls it into the viewport - section reveals, dashboard cards below the fold
RoboInView.whenNotToUse: Immediate on-mount entrances - use RoboFadeIn or RoboSlideIn; respects prefers-reduced-motion automatically
RoboInView.a11y: Honors prefers-reduced-motion via useReducedMotion - content renders without motion for users who opt out

RoboNumberTicker.description: Animated numeric counter that springs from a start value to a target value with locale formatting
RoboNumberTicker.whenToUse: Animating KPI or metric values on dashboards when the number changes or first appears
RoboNumberTicker.whenNotToUse: Static values that never change - render text directly; RoboStatCard already integrates value animation via animateValue
RoboNumberTicker.a11y: Honors prefers-reduced-motion - renders the final value immediately for users who opt out

RoboStagger.description: Staggers the entrance of its direct children with configurable delay and slide offset
RoboStagger.whenToUse: Animating lists, grids, or card collections in one item at a time for hierarchy and polish
RoboStagger.whenNotToUse: Single elements - use RoboFadeIn or RoboSlideIn; large virtualized lists where offscreen items should not animate
RoboStagger.a11y: Honors prefers-reduced-motion - children render in place without motion for users who opt out

RoboTextEffect.description: Per-word or per-character text entrance animation (fade, slide-up, or blur)
RoboTextEffect.whenToUse: Hero headings and empty-state titles where a short piece of text should enter with emphasis
RoboTextEffect.whenNotToUse: Body copy or long paragraphs - per-unit animation of long text is distracting and slow
RoboTextEffect.a11y: Honors prefers-reduced-motion - text renders statically for users who opt out; splits do not break screen-reader reading order

RoboTransitionPanel.description: Animated content switcher that transitions between keyed panels (horizontal, vertical, or fade)
RoboTransitionPanel.whenToUse: Swapping between views in place - wizard steps, tab-like content changes, rotating dashboard widgets
RoboTransitionPanel.whenNotToUse: Accessible tab semantics - use RoboTabs (which supports animateContent); route-level transitions belong to the app router
RoboTransitionPanel.a11y: Honors prefers-reduced-motion; manage focus yourself when the active panel changes in response to user input

RoboRouterAdapterProvider.description: Context provider that injects the host app router (Link component + usePathname) into Robo navigation components
RoboRouterAdapterProvider.whenToUse: Once at app root so RoboSidebar, RoboTopbar, and RoboBreadcrumbs render framework-native links (Next.js, TanStack Router)
RoboRouterAdapterProvider.whenNotToUse: Apps without client routing - the default adapter renders plain anchor tags, so omitting the provider is fine
RoboRouterAdapterProvider.a11y: Preserves aria-current wiring on active links regardless of the underlying router implementation

RoboEmailTable.description: Data-driven table rendered with inline styles only, for HTML email bodies and exported report documents
RoboEmailTable.whenToUse: Generating HTML for email bodies or report exports with renderToStaticMarkup - email clients strip stylesheets and cannot resolve CSS variables
RoboEmailTable.whenNotToUse: On-screen UI - use RoboTable (token-styled, density-aware) or RoboDataTable for interactive tables
RoboEmailTable.a11y: Real table semantics with th columnheaders and an optional caption naming the table

RoboEditorToolbar.description: Formatting toolbar for RoboRichTextEditor (marks, blocks, undo/redo)
RoboEditorToolbar.whenToUse: Inside or alongside RoboRichTextEditor when a custom editor composition needs the standard formatting controls

RoboDossierPropertyGrid.description: Two-column key/value grid for entity properties inside RoboEntityDossier - thin wrapper over RoboDescriptionList
RoboDossierPropertyGrid.whenToUse: Rendering arbitrary entity property objects inside the dossier
RoboDossierPropertyGrid.whenNotToUse: General key-value display outside the dossier - use RoboDescriptionList directly

RoboAnimatedVessel.description: Animated vessel marker that interpolates position along a track during timeline playback
RoboAnimatedVessel.whenToUse: Animating vessel movement on the map while the timeline scrubber plays

RoboTimelineTrackLayer.description: Map layer rendering historical track lines synchronized with the timeline window
RoboTimelineTrackLayer.whenToUse: Showing vessel or asset track history that follows the timeline selection

RoboTimelineVesselMarker.description: Vessel marker positioned at the timeline playhead along a track
RoboTimelineVesselMarker.whenToUse: Marking the current playback position of a vessel during timeline scrubbing

RoboDrawLayer.description: Map layer that renders shapes created by the drawing tools
RoboDrawLayer.whenToUse: Displaying user-drawn zones and annotations managed by RoboDrawProvider

RoboDrawToolbar.description: Tool palette for the map drawing system (point, line, polygon, measure modes)
RoboDrawToolbar.whenToUse: Giving users drawing mode controls on a map wrapped in RoboDrawProvider
